output.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND LOWER(c.segment) = 'enterprise'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.country
output.explanation: Revenue is the sum of net_revenue for orders flagged is_revenue, dated in calendar year 2025, for customers in the enterprise segment (matched regardless of letter case). Results are grouped by customer country, highest first. Shipping fees are not added.
